scope: Publisher policy evidence, not a legal determination or source activation

primarySources.observedPolicy: Publisher states pieces are public domain unless otherwise indicated. This is a general claim with an explicit exception, not a per-page license determination.

Project aims to collect public-domain songs with music/chords. Contributor rules ask for expired rights or an official documented permission source, and source references where possible. The same policy explicitly describes parodies with possible continuing melody rights and private/teaching scope, plus exercise examples based on protected songs.
Header guidance separates composer, text writer and arranger credits; per-song provenance remains important.
Older general help still names CC-BY-SA3.0/GFDL; it does not supersede captured runtime siteinfo/page-contribution4.0 provenance or clear underlying song rights.

decision.remaining: Integration must assess per-work exception handling and attribution/rights preservation alongside the pending native/cloud/catalog gates. Preserve explicit unknown underlying rights unless specific work evidence supports a narrower claim.
